integrity: All-parameter proof is analytical; finite symbolic and quadrature tests provide reproducibility, not an infinite certification. No external independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact real 2x2 one-probe squared-Frobenius risk only; no claim about higher dimensions, finite-probe optimality across arbitrary probe distributions, or unsquared errors. Anisotropic robust optimum may be an unattained finite-strength infimum. Publication-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp robust prior-strength boundary and risk reversal for a planar Gaussian range finder
